versions.subject: rule: Hermetic Wiper group activity
versions.detection:
selection1:
   Image|endswith: 
      - '\policydefinitions\postgresql.exe'
selection2:
   - CommandLine|contains: 
      - 'CSIDL_SYSTEM_DRIVE\temp\sys.tmp'
      - ' 1> \\127.0.0.1\ADMIN$\__16'
   - CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'powershell -c '
      - '\comsvcs.dll MiniDump '
      - '\winupd.log full'
condition: 1 of selection*
versions.spl: Image="*\\policydefinitions\\postgresql.exe" OR CommandLine IN ("*CSIDL_SYSTEM_DRIVE\\temp\\sys.tmp*", "* 1> \\127.0.0.1\\ADMIN$\\__16*") OR (CommandLine="*powershell -c *" CommandLine="*\\comsvcs.dll MiniDump *" CommandLine="*\\winupd.log full*")
